_comment: Single source of truth for API-key roles and the scopes they grant. Consumed by the Python API (dbcore/rbac.py enforces scopes per endpoint), the Qwik dashboard (role picker on /dashboard/settings) and the MCP server (filters which tools a key can see and call). Keep roles additive: each role is a superset of the previous one. Project public keys (oops_pub_*) are NOT API keys: they can only call the ingest endpoints and carry no role.

scopes.projects:read: List and read projects and their settings (including the public key).
scopes.projects:write: Create and update projects, rotate the public key, change ingest settings.
scopes.issues:read: Read issues, events, stats and the live counter.
scopes.issues:write: Resolve, ignore and reopen issues (single or bulk).
scopes.events:delete: Purge a project's stored events and issues (destructive).
scopes.usage:read: Monthly usage counters and plan limits.

viewer.label: Viewer
viewer.description: Read-only: projects, issues, events, stats, usage.

editor.label: Editor
editor.description: Viewer, plus create and update projects, rotate public keys, resolve and ignore issues.

admin.label: Admin
admin.description: Editor, plus delete projects, purge events and read the audit log.
